description: A peer's recommendation stands until its connection ends: after the link is broken the next transmission to it goes at drc.default_speed again.
note: As cas/break-responder, with a table. drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. At 2000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) carries MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long (0x885) in its EOW, recorded (interp C-1262); the request records the peer Ed4 (B-0408). No connection exists yet, so no answered rung limits the choice (interp C-1281): our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, a type 8 to 0.0.1.3 alone, goes at the MAX-SPEED rung WN 4 Long (one D_PDU, so for latency; no LOW-SPEED, so MAX-SPEED stands in, interp C-1284), its header SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04 (interp C-1286). Fixture WN 4 Long: 50 bytes and 2400 ms (test data), so the 25-byte type 8 needs one block, 3150 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, and two PADDING with CAPABILITY fill the block (C-1154). The link is made when it ends, at 55150 (B-0213, B-0400). At 61000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK breaks the link at once (B-0159, B-0284) and D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED reaches the DTS (C-0652), which ends the peer's recommendations (open question 4, interp C-1287). The PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM, also a type 8 to 0.0.1.3, therefore goes at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long (25 bytes and 4800 ms a block: EOT and window 10, the block full, no PADDING), with SENDER-APPROACH. Contention: seed 0 slots 15 then 4 (K-0080), LBT rule 1 after each burst addressed to us (K-0067). The soft link times are derived from the answer wait (A-0321), as in cas/break-responder.
